# Change the teleport power-up (P7) activation key

## Problem Statement
The teleport power-up (P7) is currently activated with the Space key. It needs to be changed to the S key or the down arrow key per product requirement.

## Users
- Player controlling the ship in the GymPowerUpsCombat scene — needs to activate teleport with S or down arrow instead of Space.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **AC1 — New activation key:** The teleport power-up activates when the S key or down arrow is pressed (depending on clarification).
- **AC2 — Space key freed:** The Space key is no longer used for teleport activation (and continues to work for other purposes if applicable).
- **AC3 — GDD updated:** The Game Design Document (§3 Controls table, §4.4 P7 Teleport, §6.4) is updated to reflect the new key binding.
- **AC4 — Tests pass:** All existing tests pass; any tests that check for Space key triggering are updated.
- **AC5 — Full test suite passes.**

## Constraints
- Scope is the GymPowerUpsCombat.ts gym scene (main game scene scope TBD).
- Must maintain backward compatibility with test harness (triggerTeleport method).
- Must preserve the FIFO stack behavior and Phase Shift on arrival.

## Existing State
- Teleport activates on Space key (`spaceKey` in `GymPowerUpsCombat.ts` line 272).
- GDD documents Space as the activation key across multiple sections.

## Desired Change
- Change teleport activation from Space to S or down arrow key.
- Update GDD to reflect new key binding.

## Key Files (predicted)
- `src/scenes/gym/GymPowerUpsCombat.ts` — Change `spaceKey` to use S or down arrow
- `docs/Game Design Document.md` — Update §3, §4.4, §6.4
- `src/scenes/gym/GymPowerUpsCombat.test.ts` — Update any Space-key dependent tests

## Related Work
- AH-0MTE8EBZ1002U3PX — Unit tests: P7 Teleport (completed)
- AH-0MTE8EBAH007GUO0 — Effects module: teleport (completed)
- AH-0MTE8EBG3004QC66 — Combat gym scene with teleport (completed)

## Risks & Assumptions
- **Risk:** The S key is also used for movement (WASD). This could conflict with downward movement. *Mitigation: Clarify whether both S and down arrow should work, or just one.*
- **Assumption:** Only the gym scene needs updating; the main game scene does not yet have teleport activated.
- **Assumption:** Space key is not needed for shooting or other actions in the gym scene.

## Appendix: Clarifying Questions & Answers

- Q: "Should teleport activate on EITHER the S key OR the down arrow key (both work)?" — Answer: **OPEN**
- Q: "Should it be the S key with down arrow as an alternative?" — Answer: **OPEN**
- Q: "Should the Space key still work for other actions (e.g., shooting)?" — Answer: **OPEN**
- Q: "Is the scope limited to the gym scene (GymPowerUpsCombat.ts), or should the main game scene also be updated?" — Answer: **OPEN**

# Move control buttons for gym scenes to the bottom

## Problem statement

In gym scenes, the EXPLODE and SHOOT control buttons are positioned at the top-left of the screen (y=10), overlapping with the HUD info line and obscuring important game status information.

## Users

- **Game developers testing formations** — need clear visibility of the HUD while interacting with gym controls.
- **Players in combat gyms** — need to see their ship status, score, and power-up information without obstruction.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **AC1 — Buttons moved to bottom:** The EXPLODE and SHOOT buttons are repositioned to the bottom of the screen, clear of all HUD elements.
2. **AC2 — Status text follows:** The score/status text line moves to sit alongside the buttons at the bottom of the screen.
3. **AC3 — No visual regression:** Button styling (monospace neon style) and interactivity are preserved exactly.
4. **AC4 — Back button stays:** The "← INDEX" back button remains at the top-right corner.
5. **AC5 — Hint text stays:** The bottom hint text remains at its current position.
6. **AC6 — Tests pass:** All existing gym scene tests continue to pass; any button-position assertions are updated.

## Risks & Assumptions

- **Risk — test assertions:** Some gym scene tests may assert button y-positions or viewport bounds. These will need updating. Low risk; straightforward positional changes.
- **Risk — per-scene overrides:** If any concrete gym scene (GymEnemies, etc.) sets button positions independently, those must also be updated. (Checked: buttons are created in the base class.)
- **Assumption — bottom position:** Buttons will be placed at the bottom-left, just above the hint text line. The exact y-offset is left to implementation (e.g., `GAME_HEIGHT - 30`).
- **Scope-creep risk:** The GymEnemies.ts scene has its own set of `<button>` DOM elements (Respawn, Toggle Player, Save, Save As) in a separate panel. These are outside the canvas scope and are **not** part of this change. If those also need repositioning, that is a separate task.

## Constraints

- Changes are scoped to `GymFormationScene.ts` (the shared base class for all gym formation scenes).
- No new features or behavioural changes — only repositioning.
- Maintain consistency with the existing monospace neon button style.

## Existing state

- **EXPLODE button:** `_addButton(10, 10, 'EXPLODE', LABEL_STYLE)` at top-left.
- **SHOOT button:** `_addButton(120, 10, 'SHOOT: OFF', LABEL_STYLE)` at top-left.
- **Status text:** `add.text(10, 44, ...)` just below the buttons.
- **Back button:** `addBackToIndexButton(this)` at top-right (x=GAME_WIDTH-10, y=10).
- **Hint text:** `add.text(GAME_WIDTH / 2, GAME_HEIGHT - 12, ...)` at bottom-center.
- **Screen size:** 960×540.

## Desired change

Move the EXPLODE and SHOOT buttons and status text from the top-left to the bottom-left of the screen, keeping the same horizontal layout but shifting vertically to sit just above the hint text.

## Key Files

- `src/scenes/gym/core/GymFormationScene.ts` — Reposition button creation in `create()`.
- `src/scenes/gym/core/GymFormationScene.test.ts` — Update any button-position assertions.

## Appendix: Clarifying Questions

No clarifying questions were needed — the work item description was sufficiently detailed to draft a clear brief. The codebase confirmed the exact button positions and scene structure.

## Related work

- **Gym scene refactoring:** AH-0MTAN4IFR007U9B3 (Extract reusable gym formation-scene core library)
- **Scheme-aware gym controls:** AH-0MTFRQR41000V57V
- **Gym editor panel:** AH-0MTHG5BIB006PP0P
